def partial(y,x,ctrls):
    import numpy as np
    X = df[ctrls].values
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(df)),X])
    def resid(v):
        b,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,df[v].values,rcond=None)
        return df[v].values - X@b
